annotations.rationale: The primary attempt exposes pending and visible failure, but the completed controlled trace offers no declared recovery alternative.
annotations.falsePositiveRisk: A product may intentionally route recovery outside the captured surface; this fixture contract explicitly requires retry, so broader products need their own declared scope.

annotations.rationale: The controlled primary attempt exposes pending then visible failure; the offered and activated retry reaches declared and visible success.
annotations.falsePositiveRisk: The fixture does not independently prove server-side idempotency or absence of duplicated effects, so those properties remain unclaimed.

annotations.rationale: Save draft is an explicitly accepted alternative that is offered, activated, and followed by declared and visible success; retry is not universally required.
annotations.falsePositiveRisk: A visible saved state does not independently prove durable storage; the rule evaluates only the declared controlled contract.

annotations.rationale: The declared action is immediate and has no failure-recovery obligation; neither rule may manufacture an applicable target.
annotations.falsePositiveRisk: A falsely declared immediate action could hide a real latency problem, so production contracts require review and cannot be inferred from one fast run.

annotations.rationale: The observably latent action resolves successfully with no pending or optimistic native-state observation between activation and resolution.
annotations.falsePositiveRisk: Pending feedback outside the declared target state channel would be missed; the controlled contract must name all accepted evidence sources.

annotations.rationale: App-declared pending conflicts with the native DOM state, so the disagreement remains evidence and neither rule guesses pass or failure.
annotations.falsePositiveRisk: Treating declared instrumentation as authoritative would create a false pass; treating DOM alone as authoritative would erase a diagnostic conflict.

annotations.rationale: Pending is observed after activation and before declared success resolution; no recovery contract applies to this success-only trace.
annotations.falsePositiveRisk: The public fixture validates the named state channel only and does not establish whether arbitrary users perceive the feedback.

annotations.rationale: The action and policy are declared but no controlled execution was performed, which is distinct from ambiguity and inapplicability.
annotations.falsePositiveRisk: Coercing absent execution to pass would conceal coverage gaps; coercing it to fail would claim a defect without observation.
